Listen to Amal, Out Everywhere:
https://levantine.ampl.ink/Amal

-

Covering my all time favorite musician; Hugo Leclercq (Madeon)'s masterpiece "Dream Dream Dream" from his sophomore album "Good Faith"
-
All sounds you hear are made using Voice and Mouth.
-
Song was made using FL Studio 20 and Ableton Live 10 Suite, using Focusrite Recording Bundle.
